description: Guru is a knowledge management platform for teams to organize, search, and govern internal knowledge, cards, pages, collections, and connected sources. It also offers AI-oriented access to that knowledge through APIs and an MCP server.
summary: Guru exposes a documented REST API at `https://api.getguru.com/api/v1/` and a streamable-HTTP MCP server at `https://mcp.api.getguru.com/mcp`; both require authentication, primarily via Guru-issued API credentials, with the MCP server also documented as supporting OAuth 2.0.
